text:
maria: Heads-up — planning NIC firmware sequence in az5 next Tue 02:00-06:00 UTC. We need a rolling drain per rack to avoid cross-rack traffic loss. :warning:
jon: +1. Do we have a rack ordering? last time we inadvertently drained two adjacent racks and saw mesh reconvergence spikes. :grimacing:
kai: Suggest ordering by top-of-rack vendor id (ToR-01 -> ToR-08). That keeps inter-rack uplinks intact during hops. I can generate the list.
infra-bot: deploy-bot scheduled: NIC firmware run for region=az5 window=2098765432-2098769032 — jobs queued: 0
maria: Kai, please paste the ordering when you have it. Also need evacuation plan for GPUs running long tails (dedicated pools + batch).
jon: For Dedicated customers we need to avoid evicting >10% of capacity in a 15m window. Proposal: stagger by tenant pool — drain non-critical pools first, then do canary node for critical pools.
ashley: Can we shift some traffic to eu-west while az5 drains? Latency hit but keeps SLAs for customers with multi-region routes. That will increase egress costs though. :money_with_wings:
costops-bot: Quick calc: expected extra egress + burst VMs ~ $1.8k for 4h if we route 30% to eu-west. Keeping 2 spare warm reserved instances in az5 estimates ~ $2.4k for the same window.
maria: Good — so cheaper to redirect some traffic than to pay for warm spares. Let's prefer routing with a fallback to warm spares if traffic is >60% of baseline.
kai: Ordering pasted: ToR-03, ToR-01, ToR-05, ToR-07, ToR-02, ToR-04, ToR-08, ToR-06. I'll open a sheet with node lists + pods per node. Use `kubectl drain <node> --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=120` as usual.
sre-oncall: On-call plan: page SRE for any reconnect spikes > 2000 p50 req/s or instance reattach time > 45s. We'll hold the next rack if we see packet loss > 1% for > 3 minutes.
jon: Also add KV cache warming step after each rack drain — prefix cache miss was painful last time. Plan: after node comes back, run `cache-warm --prefix examples --concurrency 4` for 10m.
maria: Communication: prod-alerts channel, update status.redwoodinfra.com with expected degraded metrics for 1hr blocks, email SLA customers with A/B plan (route -> warm spares). I'll draft the note.
ashley: One more ask: postpone any big retrain/batch jobs in az5 24h before/after window to reduce tail loads. I'll post a cron to block long jobs.
maria: Sounds good. Final checklist: ordering (kai) ✅, on-call rota (sre-oncall) ✅, cost fallback thresholds (costops-bot) ✅, comms draft (maria) in 1h. Will run a dry-run on staging Fri 22:00 UTC. :thumbsup:
infra-bot: reminder scheduled: dry-run-staging Fri 22:00 UTC -> runbook: https://confluence.redwood.internal/runbooks/az5-nic-firmware
jon: If anyone wants to add mitigations to the runbook, ping me.
maria: Thanks all — will post final sign-off by EOD today. :wave:
